peg.feature_provenance: Public CAD cap underside at +8.925 mm in authored coordinates scaled by 0.001 m/unit. Local +Y points from shaft toward head: relative to this datum the shaft extends to -22 mm and the head to +4.15 mm. This defines a directed part axis, not a tool approach or scene position

hub-cover.feature_provenance: Public CAD underside flange Y=-2.9705mm and independently fitted circular axis X/Z scaled to 0.001 m/source unit; root origin is not the bore centre; no scene position

hub-cover-input.feature_provenance: Public collision mesh bounds and sampled geometry support local +X as the short bore axis; plug_main supplies the local origin. No scene pose is exposed; physical fit requires calibration

hub-cover-small.feature_provenance: Public collision mesh bounds and sampled geometry support local +X as the short bore axis; plug_main supplies the local origin. No scene pose is exposed; physical fit requires calibration
